```{r Load in packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidytext)
```


```{r Create lyrics dataframe/tibble}
fav_lyrics <- c("Pull me, oh, so close",
                "'Cause you never know",
                "Just how long our lives will be")
fav_lyrics_df <- tibble(line = 1:3, lyric = fav_lyrics)
fav_lyrics_df
```

```{r One word per row}
fav_lyrics_df |> unnest_tokens(word, lyric)
```
